description: The proposed candidate_path failed the daemon's local safety policy (e.g. a sensitive system directory). The daemon rejects the bind with the typed unsafe_path error and leaves the project local_workspace_unbound. The hosted-safe view never carries the rejected local path.

proposal.reason: Editor was opened at a system directory.

error.message: Candidate path failed the local safety policy.

hosted_safe_view.status_message: Proposed folder was rejected as unsafe. Choose a project folder to bind.
